title: Real-Time Whole-Body Control of Legged Robots with Model-Predictive Path Integral Control
notes: Source: arXiv:2409.10469v1 [cs.RO], 16 Sep 2024 (7 pages; byte-identical to the arXiv PDF). Authors: Juan Alvarez-Padilla, John Z. Zhang, Sofia Kwok, John M. Dolan, Zachary Manchester (Carnegie Mellon University). The page-1 box 'This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. ...' is kept once. External metadata not printed in the PDF: the project website whole-body-mppi.github.io links the code repository github.com/jrapudg/RTWholeBodyMPPI (MIT licence); website, videos, code and the per-task hyperparameter list are not part of this package.

Mathematics is transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' arXiv TeX source and checked against the PDF; display equations (1)-(4) carry their printed numbers as \tag{n}; equation (3) is one two-line aligned block with one number.
Algorithm 1 (page 3) is kept as an image followed by a line-numbered transcription (nesting shown with ' '); the authors' pseudocode is reproduced as printed.

Authors' slips are kept as printed, for example 'modification better scale MPPI' (Section II-B), Algorithm 1 line 6 'using $u_n$' while the loop samples $u_t$, equation (2) without a sample index on $u_t$, equation (1) reusing $n$ as the summation index, the lower-case 'in Sec. IV-E' opening a sentence, 'Across all hard experiments' (hardware), '$\lambda = \sim 0.1$' (printed 'λ =∼ 0.1'), 'interactions between the robot body', '(Fig 7)', the run-in title '5) Number samples:', 'can not see'.

Figures 2, 6 and 7 are vector graphics whose labels, tick values, legends and the ×10^6 / ·10^6 axis multipliers exist only in the image crops; the plotted values of Figs. 6 and 7 are not tabulated in the paper.

Table I (page 6) is printed with its caption below the table; the two-line column headers ('Offline Training', 'Whole-Body Contact') are joined with a space in one header cell and the first header cell is empty.

Floats are placed at paragraph boundaries near their printed position (for example Fig. 2 at the end of Section I, Fig. 3 and Algorithm 1 under II-B, Fig. 4 under IV-A, Table I at the end of IV-E); search for 'Fig. N', 'Algorithm 1' or 'TABLE I'. Subsection letters restart in every section, so 'A.' and 'B.' occur several times; the parent section disambiguates them.
source_review_notes: All 7 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (reports/review-pages-0001-0007.md): equations (1)-(4) and inline maths transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' TeX and compared with 220 dpi crops; Figures 1-7 checked on all four edges (native labels of Figs. 2, 6, 7 inside the crops); Algorithm 1 kept as a crop with a line-numbered transcription; Table I checked cell by cell; references [1]-[32] reordered and split where the extractor had misplaced or merged them, every third entry checked character by character. Verifier diagnostics on pages 2-7 are LaTeX-notation, algorithm-transcription and one rejoined access date, adjudicated per page.
